name: They Once Had Names
source:
"Long ago we called them "kaiju." Now they’re just meat."

A short toxic yuri VN about being used and having sex in stomach acid.

[From [url=https://basicbean.itch.io/they-once-had-names]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
「很久以前，我們叫它們『怪獸』。如今，它們不過是肉。」

一部描寫有毒百合關係的短篇視覺小說，講的是被人利用，以及在胃酸裡做愛。
